title: Ana's B&B - My first vibecoded game
author: Smart_Breakfast_6165
selftext:
Hi everybody,

Not related to my previous post, but this was my very first vibecoding test for a cozy management simulator I coded on a character of mine. I'm leaving it for free here:  
[https://github.com/LillianEdgecombe/claude\_ana\_test](https://github.com/LillianEdgecombe/claude_ana_test)

I'd love to have your feedbacks on it!

comments.author: EconomySerious
comments.body: put a readme on the repo

replies.author: EconomySerious
replies.body:
with the live version and the readme it looks ready for a star.  
its a good start, continue developing it.  
i can only advice to start deviding the files more, monolitic code is the enemy of easy to maintain code

comments.author: witmann_pl
comments.body: If you want feedback on a game, maybe share it in a playable state or at least a video and not a source code?

replies.author: Smart_Breakfast_6165
replies.body: It's playable, you just need to clone the repo and open the HTML. But maybe I should clarify this in the readme I'm adding.

replies.author: witmann_pl
replies.body: What I meant is you should put it on [itch.io](http://itch.io) or whatever other platform accepting web games and not force your user to download the code and run it themselves. If you're asking people for somethings, it's generally a good practice to reduce their friction as much as possible. Also, a short video would help to determine if your game is even worth playing in the first place.

replies.author: Smart_Breakfast_6165
replies.body: I see, thanks for the insights! I'll do it.

replies.author: Smart_Breakfast_6165
replies.body: As suggested, I made the game totally playable from the browser and added the link to the main post.
